## Summary
Implements **P0.09** — the artifact pipeline between tables and files (spec §11.5/§12.2/§12.6/§12.8, §8.2/§8.4). Adds a new pure, dependency-injected package **`@rhema/mirror`** that owns the materialize/harvest/delivery seam every workflow crosses, plus the orchestrator wiring that runs the delivery transaction at `finalizing → completed`. Nothing else writes canonical artifact storage.

Spec: `docs/tickets/10_P0.09__mirror-harvest-delivery.md`.

## What changed
- **`packages/mirror`** (`@rhema/mirror`, new):
  - `materialize.ts` — per-seat mirror from committed artifacts (+ gate `overlays[]`); the **server-generated hydration manifest** (path → `artifact_version_id` + sha256); `manifest.md` from tables (REQ-VIS-6). Mounts exactly the §12.6 seat tables by reusing `@rhema/hooks` `SEAT_MOUNTS`, so the Editor tree structurally omits `agents/author/**`, voice-print/lexicon/exemplars, and `preferences.md`. `materializeScoped` reuses `@rhema/engine`'s enumeration (second read = `[draft]`).
  - `harvest.ts` + `persist.ts` — write-back diff vs the manifest: read-only hash check (a `chmod +w` edit fails the step), write-allowlist filter with out-of-allowlist / immutable-path writes dropped and counted `boundary.violation` (>5 or an immutable write ⇒ quarantine), changed/new files versioned by the path→kind map, identical files unversioned.
  - `validation.ts` — sidecar validation (parsers), cited⇒fetched (`claim.url` **and** every `claim.sources[].url` vs the proxy fetch log), the model-independent verdict source check (§12.8(c) downgrade to `unverifiable` + `sourceCheck:'suspicious_source'`), the second-read producer check.
  - `delivery.ts` — the delivery transaction: correspondence + claims + claim_sources + findings, mark delivered artifacts immutable, freeze the input draft, run the obligation spawn/join **hook** (P0.12 seam; default no-op), emit `boundary.attested` + the access_report `artifact.written`. A validation failure throws → the run ends `failed(validation)`; the ledger debit stays a separate retried transaction.
  - `attestation.ts` — `access_report` from **server-side facts only** (the hydration manifest, the proxy fetch log, the subagent launch records, and the in-container audit as secondary "attempts"); `ITERATION_CAPS` budgets.
  - `freeze.ts` — freeze one-way; `v(N+1)` `origin='human_revision'`.
- **Migration `0009`** (additive) — `run_mounts` (persisted hydration manifest) + `subagent_launches` (+ Drizzle tables; schema-parity green).
- **`@rhema/orchestrator`** — `hydration()` now generates + persists the manifest server-side (`run_mounts`); `deliverRun` wires the delivery transaction into `finalizing → completed` (release hold, `cost.final`, revoke credentials) with `failed(validation)` on failure.

## Design decisions
- **Server-generated manifest is the attestation root.** `hydration()` builds and persists the manifest (not the sandbox), so "which paths were mounted for which seat" is provable — "never mounted" is provable, "never read" is not.
- **Unknown writable path ⇒ fail the step** (the spec's "default by directory *or fail*" — fail-closed branch).
- **Delivery emits `artifact.written` for the access_report** (not `run.report`, which implies a `run_report` artifact).
- **New package, not orchestrator-internal**, so run-task and P0.12 can consume materialize/harvest without pulling in the whole run lifecycle; no dep cycle (mirror never depends on orchestrator).

## Acceptance criteria → evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| Golden: materialize + immediate harvest → 0 new versions on the three real projects (REQ-DATA-9a) | `packages/mirror/src/materialize.test.ts` (proj_pv/proj_sd/proj_cr) |
| Seat-mount: Editor excludes `agents/author/**`, voice files, `preferences.md`; second read = `[draft]` | `materialize.test.ts` (Editor-exclusion + Drafter-inclusion + `materializeScoped`) |
| Fixture dossier citing a URL absent from the proxy log → `failed(validation)`, partial, nothing immutable (also `sources[].url`) | `validation.test.ts`, `delivery.test.ts` (AC3) |
| `chmod +w` + edit of a read-only mirror file → harvest hash-check fails the step | `harvest.test.ts` (AC4) |
| Out-of-allowlist write dropped + counted `boundary.violation`; >5 or an immutable-artifact write quarantines | `harvest.test.ts` (AC5) |
| Verdict source check: suspicious Tier-1 verdict downgraded to `unverifiable`+`suspicious_source`; citation-matching passes | `validation.test.ts`, `delivery.test.ts` (AC6) |
| `access_report`: mounted-path counts from the manifest, fetch counts from the proxy log, subagent scoping, denied attempts; dossier renders it | `attestation.test.ts` (AC7) |
| Delivery atomicity: obligation-hook crash rolls back all of it; a retried ledger debit never rolls back a delivered dossier | `delivery.test.ts`, `packages/orchestrator/src/delivery.test.ts` (AC8) |
